                   JOHN C. AND SHERRI L. MARTIN’S REPLY BRIEF

       John C. and Sherri L. Martin, Intervenors adversely affected by link G41, file this reply
brief regarding which proposed transmission-line route is the best alternative.
       No intervenor initial briefs advocate for a specific route with link G41; they focus on other
specific routes or just oppose routes which include links which adversely affect them.
       Commission Staff recommends route 487, which does not include link G41. Staff Ex. 1.
Staff’s initial brief advocates for route 487. Thus, Staff does not advocate for a link G41 route.
       Applicants proposed 122 routes, any of which they are willing to build. Appls. Ex. 1. They
identified route 894 as best meeting the routing criteria, id., identified 8 “routes of interest” that
became the focus of attention, Appls. Ex. 22 (including routes 894 and 487), and noted route 894-
West.-Mod-1 emerged as another such route in the evidentiary hearing (Appls. In. Brf. at 42).
None contain link G41. Applicants’ rebuttal testimony (Appls. Ex. 5 & 13) and Initial Brief (at
40-49) confirm that they still consider route 894 to be “best-meets” and are still willing to build
any approved route using its proposed links. Therefore, Applicants do not specifically advocate
for a link G41 route, they simply stand by all their proposed routes and links.
       Accordingly, the approved route should not include link G41, especially because no initial
briefs specifically advocate for a link G41 route.

                                               Respectfully submitted,
